game.title: Middle-earth: Shadow of War
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in Mordor, from Monolith Productions (published by Warner Bros. Interactive), released 2017-09-27. RAWG average playtime: 13 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Talion's war against Sauron across the regions of Mordor. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Nemesis, Followers and Your Army
chapters.summary: Warchiefs, captains, spies, death threats, shaming, fight pits, vendettas and building your orc army.

chapters.title: Sieges and Online Play
chapters.summary: Assault teams, siege upgrades, starting a conquest, and the online vendettas and conquests.

chapters.title: Exploring Mordor
chapters.summary: Monuments, outposts, Ithildin doors, Gondorian artifacts, Shelob memories, Haedir, Shadow of the Past missions and beasts.

chapters.title: Gems, Gear and Skills
chapters.summary: Forging gems, gem slots, gear challenges, legendary sets and unlocking every skill.

chapters.title: Eltariel's Path
chapters.summary: Playing as Eltariel: the Rogue Nazgûl, Seregost, Cirith Ungol, the Fixer and the Lawless.

chapters.title: Baranor and the Desolation of Mordor
chapters.summary: Playing as Baranor in Lithlad: Serka, the Oasis, the Fortress of Shindrâm and Númenórean artifacts.

StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Middle-earth:_Shadow_of_War
Fandom (middle-earth.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://middle-earth.fandom.com/wiki/Middle-earth:_Shadow_of_War
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs) with no subpages at all. middle-earth.fandom.com answers the API, with about 53 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Kraken" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 356190. 11 of 72 Steam achievements are hidden and all sit in the main story chapter. The last 19 achievements (from "Banished Ambition" to "Shadows of the Sand") have low unlock rates (about 2 to 13 percent) and name Eltariel or Baranor, so they look like extra story content, probably DLC; the data does not name the DLC, so the chapters are named after the characters and places in the descriptions. "I See the Light" (Light Trap) and "Complete in Defeat" (defeat the Lawless) do not name Eltariel; they were put in her chapter by schema position, which needs checking. "Eastern Front" (Shindrâm as Talion) was put in the Baranor chapter because it names the same fortress. "Kill a Captain while riding an Olog" sits in the nemesis chapter.
